cohort: The study focuses on a single case of a fetus diagnosed with total atrioventricular block, whose mother is a transgender man with systemic lupus erythematosus and positive anti-Ro/SSA antibodies.
finding: This case illustrates that while terbutaline can temporarily increase fetal ventricular rate in TAVB, a pacemaker is ultimately indicated, and delivery should ideally occur at term to allow for adequate fetal development before definitive pacemaker implantation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was indicated at 35 weeks and 4 days of gestation due to premature rupture of ovular membranes.
gest_age: Follow-up began at 31 weeks and 3 days of gestation; delivery occurred at 35 weeks and 4 days of gestation.
